problem: Semantic Hyperposition is now a cross-cutting multi-branch operating frame, but future J-Space carrier geometry must not silently re-collapse that ontology by assuming the complete state can or should be represented by one rank-1 control vector.

external_research.source: arXiv:2310.15213 Function Vectors in Large Language Models
external_research.source_claim: Compact internal function representations can have causal cross-context effects. Output-space information is present but insufficient by itself to reconstruct the full function vector, and composition is only partial in the reported experiments.
external_research.project_implication: Keep semantic computation/state separate from runtime codebook/output symbols and test composition rather than assuming exact linear semantics.

external_research.source: arXiv:2506.09048 Understanding Task Vectors in In-Context Learning: Emergence, Functionality, and Limitations
external_research.source_claim: The paper predicts and empirically reports limitations of single task vectors on high-rank mappings and discusses multiple-vector injection as an enhancement.
external_research.project_implication: A single-vector Hyperposition/J-Space carrier is a hypothesis to test, not a target-architecture invariant.

external_research.source: arXiv:2501.09240 Task Vectors in In-Context Learning: Emergence, Formation, and Benefit
external_research.source_claim: Task information can be weak or non-local; an auxiliary task-vector prompting loss can encourage stronger task information at a prescribed model location in the studied synthetic setting.
external_research.project_implication: If representation-level supervision is later admitted, carrier localization should be an ablation target rather than assumed to exist in the current Qwen target.

external_research.source: arXiv:2602.02132 There Is More to Refusal in Large Language Models than a Single Direction
external_research.source_claim: Distinct refusal/non-compliance categories can occupy geometrically distinct directions while interventions along them produce similar refusal/over-refusal trade-offs.
external_research.project_implication: Similar behavioral steering effects do not identify one unique semantic axis; preserve operationally equivalent carrier hypotheses until a model-specific discriminator separates them.

preregistered_carrier_hypotheses.description: One rank-1 task/control vector represents the complete current semantic-Hyperposition episode.
preregistered_carrier_hypotheses.risk: May compress away branch-local identities, evidence attachments or high-rank symbolic mappings while still supporting a coarse behavior shift.

preregistered_carrier_hypotheses.description: K branch-local vectors plus a deterministic set/attention readout preserve live alternatives explicitly.
preregistered_carrier_hypotheses.risk: May improve branch recoverability but introduce ordering/identity leakage or excess coordination cost.

preregistered_carrier_hypotheses.description: A low-rank learned subspace/basis carries the episode, with branch states represented as coordinates or components inside the subspace.
preregistered_carrier_hypotheses.risk: May still hide non-identifiable rotations and requires invariance to basis choice; subspace readability is not causal semantics.

minimum_comparative_evaluation: Freeze one semantic family/split manifest before carrier comparison; do not tune on holdout.
Use identical A/B/C/D/E task semantics and model-visible prompts across carrier variants where feasible.
Include held-out fantasy predicates and deliberately higher-rank semantic mappings, not only three-class binding.
Measure task behavior plus branch-local recoverability of v/K/E_plus/E_minus/F/T/A/sigma after nondiscriminating updates.
Run branch permutation/renaming and codebook permutation/remap controls.
Run carrier lesion/shuffle/rescue or equivalent model-specific interventions before any positive causal interpretation.
Measure off-target retention and general language/code degradation against frozen baseline.
Test vector/subspace composition separately; do not infer composition from single-carrier success.
Report layer/token-position/intervention-strength transfer as new hypotheses, never inherited validity.
Keep synthetic task resolution distinct from causal evidence resolution and canonical truth authority.

architecture_feedback.xeno: The finished Qwen3.5-0.8B cognitive module should learn semantic Hyperposition relations and branch-preserving computations independently of whether the best physical carrier later turns out to be rank-1, multi-vector or subspace-like.
architecture_feedback.global_jspace: J-Space ABI should permit a versioned carrier descriptor instead of hard-coding one physical vector as the unique semantic object.
architecture_feedback.hcu: HCU cells/workspace should exchange typed semantic state plus carrier identity/provenance; carrier geometry remains a measured implementation choice rather than a new state authority.
architecture_feedback.training: Training rows should target invariant semantic relations and branch-local state first. Any auxiliary representation-localization/carrier loss must be separately typed and ablated.

counterhypothesis: The target Qwen3.5-0.8B model may already encode the complete relevant semantic process sufficiently in one compact direction, making multi-vector/subspace machinery unnecessary.
falsifier: A preregistered rank-1 carrier that matches or beats multi-vector/subspace alternatives on held-out high-rank mappings, branch-local recoverability, permutation/remap invariance, composition tests, off-target retention and causal lesion/rescue at exact model identity would support retaining the simpler rank-1 carrier at that measured scope.
nonclaims: No claim that the current Qwen target has a rank-1, multi-vector or subspace Hyperposition carrier.
No model-specific causal carrier evidence was executed in this research delta.
No accepted training examples or dataset tokens are created here.
No runtime/HCU/EntityOS/J-Space model credit is minted.
External papers are method/evidence inputs and do not transfer their model-specific findings to Qwen3.5-0.8B.
next_exact_action: After the derivation-bound D/E labeler and Hyperposition-native high-coverage generator are stable, add a frozen carrier-rank evaluation manifest comparing HP-CARRIER-R1, HP-CARRIER-RK and HP-CARRIER-SUBSPACE on the same held-out semantic families before any J-Space carrier architecture is promoted.
